name: ArenaToastPlacement
description: Which corner the stack of notices is pinned to, block edge first. Checked against every enum already declared here before it was added; nothing carries this set. ArenaMenuAlign is the near miss and is a different question: it names which edge of a trigger a panel lines up with, on one axis, where this names a corner of the viewport and needs both. The inline half is `start`/`end` rather than left/right so a right-to-left reading flips it with the document.
